title: How does an Auto Loans borrower enroll a loan in autopay?
content:
# How does an Auto Loans borrower enroll a loan in autopay?

This entry of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower enrolls an auto loan in autopay from one of their PCB checking accounts. It is handled on the borrower's request.

## Policy

1. When a borrower enrolls an auto loan in autopay from one of their PCB checking accounts, the APR recorded on the enrollment is rebuilt from its components.
2. **Entry condition.** No autopay enrollment stands on the loan when a new enrollment is recorded.
3. A new enrollment is recorded only on a loan with no enrollment standing. When the borrower moves autopay to a different checking account, the standing enrollment is first cancelled under its own rule, and the enrollment is then recorded from the new account. Where an enrollment still stands, the new enrollment is not recorded.

Observable effect for the borrower: autopay shows as on, together with the paying account and the new APR on the loan.

## Tool: enroll_autopay_b9bffdb4

**Situation of use and capability.** Enrolls, on the borrower's own instruction, one of their auto loans in automatic monthly payment from a PCB checking account they name, and records the APR that applies with the enrollment. One call marks the loan as enrolled, records the checking account each installment will be drawn from, records the APR and the list of discounts included in it as given, and registers a completed autopay change request on the loan as the record of the borrower's instruction. No payment is moved now.

**How it is invoked.** A customer's own tool: it must first be unlocked with unlock_user_discoverable_tool and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| auto_loan_id | the auto loan reference number of the loan being enrolled, from the auto loan lookup for this borrower | reference number |
| autopay_source_account_id | the checking account reference number of the PCB checking account installments will be drawn from, from the checking account lookup | reference number |
| interest_rate | the APR with the enrollment | percent, 2 decimal places (6.99 means 6.99 percent) |
| rate_discounts | the discounts included in the APR with the enrollment | one of the enum values below |

Enum values of rate_discounts:

- none: no discount is included in the APR;
- autopay: only the autopay discount is included in the APR;
- relationship: only the checking relationship discount is included in the APR;
- autopay_and_relationship: both the autopay and the relationship discount are included in the APR.

**Return.** On success the receipt shows status "autopay_enrolled" with: request_id (reference number of the completed autopay change request), auto_loan_id, autopay_source_account_id (the paying checking account), autopay_enrolled (true), interest_rate (percent, 2 decimal places) and rate_discounts (the enum value recorded).

## Basis Q&A

**The loan already has autopay from another account; can the new account simply be enrolled on top?** No. The standing enrollment is first cancelled under its own rule, and only then is the enrollment recorded from the new account.

**Does enrolling take a payment now?** No. The call records the enrollment and the APR; no payment is moved now.
